messages:
Aisha - Partnerships: Partner SI flagged failures during their integration run: containers with CUDA 12.2 + driver 540.xx sometimes hit driver-reset / kernel panic on A100 under sustained throughput. Need quick triage before marketplace rotation and the SI joint announcement.
Noah - Eng Infra: Ouch. Do we have crash dumps or core dumps? Can we repro with our CI canary?
Rina - Runtime: I ran a stress harness overnight. Repro pattern: sustained multi-gpu allreduce + long sequences (seq=4096) triggers a reset on 540.3 but not on 535.86. Also saw some ROCm 5.7 nodes report hang-ish behavior during NCCL comms.
Carlos - Marketplace: Marketplace images were prepared with 540 to capture perf gains. If we revert to 535 we lose some throughput on H100 runs. For SI customers we could publish a pinned "stable" channel that uses 535 and a beta channel that uses 540 with warnings.
Aisha - Partnerships: Let's avoid breaking the SI onboarding. Proposal: pin the marketplace stable image to 535 and flag 540 as experimental for now. Also tell the SI to freeze their acceptance tests until we sign off.
SI Bot: canary-job created: CI-789 / a100-stress / started. Logs: https://ci.redwood/test/CI-789
Noah - Eng Infra: I'll run the canary across a matrix: 535.x + 540.x, CUDA 12.1/12.2, ROCm 5.6/5.7 on internal lab. If 540 reproducible we'll open vendor escalation with kernel logs.
Rina - Runtime: Add runtime gating: memory-safety smoke, NCCL allreduce stability, and driver-reset detection for nightly. I'll add a hook to upload dmesg + nv-crash logs to the artifact store.
Carlos - Marketplace: Action: hold marketplace rotation to 540. I'll create a hold flag and update marketplace docs with the stable/beta channels. ETA 45m.
Aisha - Partnerships: Also confirm messaging for SI teams: we should avoid a loud public announcement until stable channel validated. We can still brief the SI privately and run the demo on pinned stable image.
Noah - Eng Infra: Found a repro in lab: 540.3 triggers reset at ~2 hours on sustained allreduce with batch=16. Attaching short log snippet: `kernel: GPU watchdog timeout - resetting device`
Rina - Runtime: If vendor provides 540.4 candidate we need acceptance criteria: 1) no resets during 8-hour throughput test, 2) NCCL 2.18 allreduce latency within 10% of baseline, 3) no ROCm hangs on MIG partitioned hardware.
Aisha - Partnerships: Good. Who owns final green sign-off for SI announcement?
Carlos - Marketplace: Marketplace rotation owner will only flip once infra posts green. I can hold the public marketplace note.
Noah - Eng Infra: Infra will own validation and vendor escalation. Contact: driver-escalate@vendor.example.com. I'll file BR-812 with traces.
Rina - Runtime: Small ask: if we pin to 535, runtime should run a perf calibration pass because some automated tuning targeted 540-specific kernels. I'll queue that.
Aisha - Partnerships: I'll update the joint announcement timeline: delay public release by 48h, run a private demo with SI on pinned image tomorrow. Draft note: "We've paused the broad driver rotation while we validate a vendor hotfix; SI customers will use our stable pinned images for onboarding." Will circulate.
Carlos - Marketplace: Hold placed: marketplace/stable -> driver 535.86, marketplace/beta -> driver 540.x (experimental). Added opt-in docs and big-warning.
SI Bot: CI-789 completed: a100-stress with 540 = FAIL (reset), 535 = PASS. Logs at https://ci.redwood/test/CI-789/logs
Noah - Eng Infra: Confirmed failure in CI. Opening vendor ticket BR-812 and attaching kernel oops, nvcrash, and canary traces.
Aisha - Partnerships: I'll notify SI PMs and ask legal if the joint announcement language needs adjustment. Thanks all.
Carlos - Marketplace: Once vendor verifies fix, we'll stage a beta rotation and then promote to stable after infra sign-off. Keeping the marketplace hold until then. :lock:
